name: AWS Knowledge MCP Server
summary: A managed remote MCP server from AWS that searches and reads AWS documentation, API references, What's New posts, Well-Architected guidance, CDK and CloudFormation references, regional availability data and AWS agent skills. The vendor says it needs no AWS account and no authentication, at no cost, under rate limits; measured true for initialize, tools/list and each of the five tools, one keyless call apiece.

agentAccess.notes: Keyless, 2026-09-11 to 2026-10-01: initialize, tools/list and all five aws___ tools called, one request each, every call 200 with isError false. Names carry an aws___ prefix the README omits; unprefixed names refused inside a 200. One 429 seen 2026-09-30; no number published or measured.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-24. One price statement, the GA post: "The server is publicly accessible at no cost and does not require an AWS account." The server page speaks to authentication and rate limits, not price. Nothing prices a call; nothing answered a 402. Rate limits published as no number.

jobs.summary: AWS documentation, API references, code samples, troubleshooting guides, Well-Architected guidance, CDK and CloudFormation references and Strands Agents SDK docs, searched and read into an agent's context over a hosted MCP server; the vendor's claim, retrieval quality not measured.
